# Clementine

> Clementine is a 100% client-side file converter. Images, audio, video,
> documents and subtitles are converted entirely in the browser using Canvas,
> WebCodecs (where available) and FFmpeg compiled to WebAssembly. No file is
> ever uploaded, and there is no server-side API.

Base URL: https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com

## Agent instructions

- [instructions.md](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/instructions.md): how to drive the
  site with a headless browser (Playwright) to convert files, including stable
  selectors and a complete example.

## Supported conversions

- Images: `.jpg` `.jpeg` `.png` `.webp` `.gif` `.bmp` `.avif` → PNG, JPG, WEBP
- Audio: `.mp3` `.m4a` `.wav` `.flac` `.ogg` `.opus` `.aac` `.aiff` `.wma` →
  MP3, M4A, WAV, FLAC, OGG, OPUS
- Video: `.mp4` `.mov` `.mkv` `.webm` `.avi` `.wmv` → MP4, MOV, MKV, WEBM, GIF,
  MP3
- Documents: `.pdf` `.docx` `.txt` → TXT, PDF, PNG pages, JPG pages
- Subtitles: `.srt` `.vtt` → SRT, VTT, TXT

## Usage

There is no HTTP endpoint. Automate the UI with a headless browser; see
[instructions.md](https://YOUR-DOMAIN.com/instructions.md) for a working
Playwright example and the list of stable selectors.

## Privacy

All processing happens locally in the browser. Files never leave the user's
device and no analytics or tracking are used.
